notes.title: Update 1.02 - Wine, Champagne, Bottles, New Belgium taps!
notes.content:
Another fairly substantial update was just posted:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28367937/6563d83b722fb7b14f7b7581bb1be6f94cb6bb5d.jpg[/img]

- New bottles to purchase. Wine / Champagne / Bottled Drinks
- Wine glasses and champagne glasses to go with these
- Ability to open cooler doors. Certain items will be spawned in coolers
- Bottle cap opener to open bottles of Light Beer, Root Beer, and Ginger Beer
- Updated pint glass shape
- Added two new beer taps featuring New Belgium brews! Voodoo Ranger and Fat Tire
- Added item labels when hovering (turn this off in the settings.)
- Should be easier to choose garnishes correctly
- Moved ginger beer to a bottle, added water in its place on the soda gun
- Added a chalkboard behind the player to show how many drinks have been unlocked
- Bug fixes: Liquid artifacts in shaker, buying items after tutorial, other misc.

notes.title: Update Incoming!
notes.content:
Cheers!

I just wanted to let everyone know of a fairly substantial update that is coming in the next week or so. It will include the following improvements:

- Improved UI
- Ice tongs have been added
- Drinks can now spill / pour into other glasses and the counter
- Drinks no longer fill up when upside down or sideways
- A shaker has been added, some drinks need to be shaken
- Minor improvements to art / decor of the bar
- Can toggle metric units (cL) on and off
- Fixed a few bugs with custom drinks
- Recipe card now shows glass and method of creation

I'm going to try to put out a free demo as well soon. After this update, I will be working fully on re-vamping the main gameplay mode and adding human patrons to the bar. My current idea is to have a full bar management type setup where you will still start with money, but bottles will run out and you'll have to buy more, breaking glasses / spilling drinks will cost money, etc. Then you can customize and buy more decor and things for the bar.

I'll try to show some gifs of these new features soon as well.

Thanks!
- DB

notes.title: Tiki Bar Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28367937/d2a412ae43728252501b8d21f3d4e03deaaca563.jpg[/img]

Hello all,

Sorry for the general lack of updates over the last month. I have moved, as well as a few other personal obligations that got in the way of development. However, I hope to add a few more features over the next few months and push updates out more regularly. This one converts the bar to a tiki shack! Just check out the settings to switch it over or back.

Thanks to Thomas Neptune ([url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/538330/AEscape_VR/]A-Escape VR[/url]) for modeling this!

Cheers
